title: Repeated leftward sweep marks
statement: Let $S$ be a deterministic Boolean-tape Turing machine and $A$ a nondeterministic Boolean-tape Turing machine, with a Boolean loop parameter and input word $x$. For any natural number $m$, choice word $w$ of length at most $m$, input-head position, and simulated-machine tape contents and head positions, if the yard head starts at $|w|-1$, then running the host machine from phase $p2$ under $w$ leaves it in phase $p2$, advances each of $A$’s work-tape heads by $|w|$, places the yard head at $-1$, and leaves the other tapes and output unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: Arbitrary simulated-machine tape contents and head positions
